newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss shares end virtually unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Swiss shares end virtually unchanged.

text.p: 1435 GMT - Swiss shares fell back from the day's highs towards the end of the session to close virtually unchanged.
Swiss Re and Roche were in the limelight, dealers said.
Swiss Re's purchase of Mercantile & General Re from Britain's Prudential Corp for around 3.15 billion francs was considered a good deal. Swiss Re advanced 31 francs, or 2.44 percent, to 1,301.
* Blue-chip Swiss Market Index (SMI) was at 3,720.0 points, up 5.4 points, or 0.15 percent, from Monday's close.
* All-share Swiss Performace Index (SPI) added 4.01 points, or 0.17 percent, to end at 2,380.47.
